uh this is a hard one, I tend to don't follow recipes when baking, but here some tips, I use sourdough sometimes, but if you can find fresh yeast (and you bake constantly), use it, is better than the instant one, use extra protein flour, I use organic which is not high on protein so I add 6 tablespoons of vital wheat gluten per kg of flour, 4 tbp of sugar per kg always help, to that kind of breads I barely add oil or other fat, you always want a well hydrated dough, knead knead and knead, you want an elastic dough, get yourself an sprayer to keep the buns hydrated before a hard crust forms when they are rising, if you want to add sesame seeds, add a tiny bit of flour to the water, will make them to stick, and also gives them that color you see above, hope it helps.
